display_name: 三个物理恢复模型的完整七景共享推理逐条复核
description: 三个原预测全部完成后，只读重算共享推理并逐条比较冻结的raw和restored分类，核对每景门控计数；不读取目标真值，不覆盖或替代原产物。

data.representation: IQ [2,256], Phase1 frozen seven-view replay; no target truth
data.tx_sets_ref: No target or source truth read in this diagnostic

roles.U_s: source smoke IQ only, identity hidden
roles.test: fixed IQ read only after all three original predictions complete

data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Controller trained using legal L_s fit labels and high-confidence frozen F pseudo labels for U_s; no U_s truth, V or test used in training
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.regime: Phase1 post-completion read-only full prediction verification
permissions.query_use: Read fixed target IQ only after three original seven-view outputs are complete; compare class predictions, no labels or adaptation
permissions.claim_scope: Technical exact class and per-view gate-count equality on already-observed Phase1 development test, no new scientific score

checkpoint.initialization: three fixed source-trained physical fusion checkpoints
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen source prediction manifests and established source contract
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: previously verified; strict metadata and model load
checkpoint.selection_rule: All three fixed original physical-fusion candidates; no selection or tuning based on replay

expected_artifacts: result.json with seven-view class equality and per-view gate counts; full waveform comparison unavailable

rows.method: read-only recomputation with shared DURA and physical posterior after original predictions complete
rows.purpose: Verify exact final raw/restored decision files and per-view gate totals
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.scenario: Phase1 fixed clean and six practical test views

notes: No original predictions, controllers, scores or logs are changed.
Waits for all three original seven-view manifests; verifies target classes without reading target truth.
Old full IQ waveforms were not saved; only per-record decisions and per-view gate counts can be verified in full.
